//: Type-checking only, like node-host: Node 24 runs the .ts sources by stripping types, so
there is no emit step and no build artefact to keep in sync.
`erasableSyntaxOnly` refuses enums, namespaces and parameter properties — anything Node's
stripper cannot erase — so a source that type-checks is a source Node can run.
`verbatimModuleSyntax` forces `import type` on type-only imports, which is the other half
of the same property, and is also what keeps a type-only import out of the emitted import
Unlike node-host this package DOES have dependencies, and they are @aztec/* only: the
orchestration, the schemas and the encoder are upstream's. `skipLibCheck` is true here and
false there, because these are third-party .d.ts files whose own errors are not ours to fix
and would make this a check about @aztec/stdlib's typings.
//include: node-host's type declarations are pulled in because src/roundtrip_cli.ts imports that
package by relative path, so tsc compiles ITS sources under THIS project. Without them,
`wasi.getImportObject()` in node-host/src/loader.ts is `object` and the build fails with a
TS2339 that is about node-host's environment rather than about anything here. node-host has
no @types/node either; the three Node APIs it uses are declared in that directory.
